about_the_game:
In the 32nd year of the Fourth Reign, on the Winter Solstice, with heavy snowfall, the police station received a message informing you that your boss died last night, suspected to be a suicide!

The world's first team-based 3D survival game with a storyline. You will team up with nine other players to read the memory of a police assistant (in the public storyline stage), and return to Bin City in the year 4032. When night falls, the nine of you can switch to other characters and start your actions (in the individual action stage). By using social interactions, facilities, items, cards and skills, you can obtain secrets, kill or destroy characters from the opposing camp. Remember, no matter what outrageous things you encounter, please always believe in science and don't trust anyone. Hope you can survive until the ninth day.
